title: 14 October 1964: Television: Scene At 6.30
content:
Prior to their evening concerts at the ABC Cinema, The Beatles recorded an appearance for the Granada television programme Scene At 6.30.

Their interview and mimed performance of ‘I Should Have Known Better’ were shown on Friday 16 October at 6.30pm in the north west of England.
